queries.name: G1 reg-lan parent law
queries.sql: SELECT count(*),sum(target_instrument_id=?1) FROM reference_edges WHERE source_provision_id LIKE ?2 AND json_extract(extras,'$.resolution_rule')='parent_shorthand'

queries.name: G2 G4 approved outdated with independent notes
queries.sql: SELECT e.resolution_status,json_extract(e.extras,'$.resolution_rule'),a.edge_id IS NOT NULL,r.edge_id IS NOT NULL,e.live_target FROM reference_edges e LEFT JOIN outdated_reference_approvals a ON a.edge_id=e.id LEFT JOIN legal_operator_reviews r ON r.edge_id=e.id WHERE e.id=?1

queries.name: G3 unavailable history
queries.sql: SELECT count(*),sum(live_target IS NULL) FROM historical_citations WHERE source_provision_id=?1 AND target_instrument_id=?2

queries.name: G3 current target remains live
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM live_citations WHERE source_provision_id=?1 AND target_provision_id=?2

queries.name: G5 LFTR missing citation
queries.sql: SELECT source_slug,multiplicity FROM cited_but_missing WHERE target_provision_id=?1

queries.name: G5 repaired CPF is absent
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM cited_but_missing WHERE source_slug='cpf'

queries.name: G6 LGTOC separate article
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM provisions WHERE id=?1

queries.name: G6 active LFD structural debt
queries.sql: SELECT json_extract(extras,'$.containing_provision_id'),json_extract(extras,'$.start_char'),json_extract(extras,'$.end_char') FROM known_structural_debt WHERE instrument_id=?1 AND printed_label=?2

queries.name: G7 accent-insensitive complete hit set
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT rowid FROM provisions_fts WHERE provisions_fts MATCH ?1 EXCEPT SELECT rowid FROM provisions_fts WHERE provisions_fts MATCH ?2)

queries.name: G7 accent-insensitive reverse hit set
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT rowid FROM provisions_fts WHERE provisions_fts MATCH ?1 EXCEPT SELECT rowid FROM provisions_fts WHERE provisions_fts MATCH ?2)

queries.name: G7 baseline hit count
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM provisions_fts WHERE provisions_fts MATCH ?1

queries.name: G8 exact Terdecies lookup
queries.sql: SELECT id FROM provisions WHERE instrument_id=?1 AND provision_type='article' AND number=?2

queries.name: definition provenance
queries.sql: SELECT defining_provision_id,json_extract(extras,'$.fraction'),json_extract(extras,'$.inciso') FROM defined_terms WHERE id=?1

queries.name: exact term usages
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM term_usages WHERE term_id=?1

queries.name: cross-instrument glossary usages
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM term_usages u JOIN defined_terms t ON t.id=u.term_id JOIN provisions p ON p.id=u.provision_id WHERE p.instrument_id<>t.instrument_id

queries.name: source provenance
queries.sql: SELECT role FROM source_manifests WHERE instrument_id=?1 ORDER BY input_path,ordinal

queries.name: analysis completeness remains explicit
queries.sql: SELECT state,count(*) FROM coverage WHERE stage='analyzed' GROUP BY state

queries.name: standards excluded from provisions
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM provisions p JOIN standards_catalog s ON s.id=p.instrument_id

queries.name: G1 adapter parent authority
queries.sql: SELECT json_extract(CAST(bytes AS TEXT),'$.parent_instrument_id') FROM input_files WHERE path=?1

queries.name: G1 source definition authority
queries.sql: SELECT instr(text,?2)>0 FROM provisions WHERE id=?1
